geometry.duplicate_method: World-space evaluated polygon topology quantized to 1 micrometre; vertex-order independent. Intersections among different assembly members are not exact duplicates.

packed_materials.scope: Exact packed generated albedo bytes and saved/source identity; not a claim of pixel quality or seamless tiling

support_contact.method: Explicit world-space anchors raycast toward named evaluated support targets. Signed gap from 100 mm prop-side offset; normal must oppose direction. Own-anchor proximity plus a triangle-intersection / <=5 mm sampled surface contact graph checks members reach an anchored member.
support_contact.limitations: Contact graph proves geometric attachment approximatively, not mechanical stress, fastening adequacy, or correct support of every hidden interior component. Intentional different-part assembly intersections are accepted; exact duplicates remain separately checked.

internal_routes.reason: Style slice does not contain full-route geometry; final acceptance requires --stage full

external_presentation_caps.neighbor_state: Neighbor files were neither imported nor modified. Existing reactor-owned doors are independently documented closed in interface.json. Removing these connector caps does not open or certify neighboring paths.

current_cartridge_core.scope: Bare current compatible body and closures. Transport straps, lifting eyes, latch hardware belong to the original carrier restraint assembly, not the bare cartridge envelope.

acceptance_scope: Technical geometry gates only; closed external caps remain explicit integration blockers. Pixel quality, repeated review cycles and final cold render comparison are separate mandatory acceptance gates.
